summary: The agent attempted hepatic panel harmonization but failed verification. The trace reveals several critical issues: (1) The agent used range-based detection that incorrectly converted values - e.g., Glucose 24.766 was converted to 10835.95 (should stay ~24.77 mg/dL, not be treated as 601.3955 mmol/L), (2) The agent applied conversions based on 'plausible ranges' that were too wide and overlapped, (3) The agent's validation only checked formatting (2 decimals, no commas) but not value correctness, (4) The skill's existing guidance on range-based detection was insufficient for hepatic panel analytes with different normal ranges. The skill needs: explicit hepatic panel conversion factors (bilirubin, albumin, protein, ammonia, bile acids, AFP), tighter detection thresholds that avoid the overlap trap, and validation that checks converted values against clinical plausibility rather than just format.
